summary: Complaints dominate on roads without drains and waterlogging, traffic jams, power cuts, dilapidated buildings and poor facilities at Khurja Junction, while appreciation centres on the new medical college, the thermal plant and the pottery (ODOP) trade.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row 70 Khurja, SC, under Bulandshahr group heading covering constituencies 64-70); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khurja_Assembly_constituency (constituency 70, SC, Bulandshahr district, extent: Khurja Tehsil)

positives.english: Khurja's medical college now teaches MBBS, so we no longer have to go to Meerut or Noida for treatment
positives.hindi: खुर्जा में मेडिकल कॉलेज शुरू हुआ, अब इलाज के लिए मेरठ-नोएडा नहीं जाना पड़ता
positives.basis: Acting principal Dr. Sanjay Mishra says the college started about two years ago and now teaches MBBS; residents earlier went to Meerut or Noida for many treatments, and several services are now local (Amar Ujala ground report). Source is a Khurja dateline; the college is in Khurja.

positives.english: A new 660 MW power unit has started at Khurja, and people expect jobs from it
positives.hindi: खुर्जा में 660 मेगावाट का नया बिजली यूनिट शुरू हुआ, रोजगार की उम्मीद है
positives.basis: First 660 MW unit of the Khurja Super Thermal Power Plant inaugurated 30 May 2025; operations began January 2025 per the article; project executive director says more than 5,000 people will get jobs (a project claim). AC membership unconfirmed: article places the plant at Dashehra village, Khurja, not verified against the tehsil extent.

positives.english: ODOP scheme and government promotion have helped Khurja's pottery business reach markets
positives.hindi: ओडीओपी और सरकारी प्रचार से खुर्जा के मिट्टी के बर्तनों का बाजार बढ़ा है
positives.basis: Trader Anshul Goyal credited government support and promotion under ODOP with helping pottery reach markets and grow; it is his account, and the article gives no sales figures.

positives.english: Road and drain work has started in Chaman Vihar colony of Khurja city
positives.hindi: खुर्जा की चमन विहार कॉलोनी में सड़क और नाली का काम शुरू हुआ है
positives.basis: Municipal board chairperson inaugurated the start of about 200 m cemented road and drain in Ward 22 Chaman Vihar colony, about Rs 22 lakh, on a Thursday in September 2026; the article says the work started, and the other road works in the same report are still future work.

positives.english: Government has sanctioned road and drain work for 21 colonies in Khurja city
positives.hindi: खुर्जा नगर की 21 कॉलोनियों में सड़क और नाली के लिए पैसा मंजूर हो गया है
positives.basis: Article (28 May 2026) says the proposal of about Rs 2.78 crore for 21 colonies has been approved, budget sanction received, and departmental tender nearly complete; work by DUDA was still in future tense, so construction had not yet started. Headline says Rs 2.78 lakh; body says crore.

negatives.english: We get only 6 to 8 hours of power cuts every day in Khurja
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा में रोज 6 से 8 घंटे बिजली कटौती झेलनी पड़ती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala district-wide table of average daily outages gives Khurja 6 to 8 hours per day (district-level article; Khurja figure from its table). Causes cited: tripping, dilapidated lines, faults, low and high voltage, summer overload. Chief Engineer says work is being done.

negatives.english: There are no drains on GT Road in Khurja, so water collects and the road breaks up
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा में जीटी रोड पर नाली नहीं, पानी भरता है और सड़क टूट रही है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline) reports a 7 km GT Road stretch from Agwal Cut to Kailash Hospital Cut, built for about Rs 14 crore, breaking within 1.5 years; no drains, waterlogging at Dadu Pottery, Naveen Sabzi Mandi and other spots; pottery entrepreneur says waterlogging hurts business. PWD XEN says only renovation and widening were sanctioned and no drainage plan is under consideration.

negatives.english: Gandhi Marg in Khurja jams from morning to evening after the dividers were removed
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा में गांधी मार्ग पर डिवाइडर हटने से सुबह से शाम तक जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline, 6 May 2026): temporary dividers removed after vehicles hit cement barricades; jam about 10 AM to 8 PM per the article; traders say sales fell 40 percent (trader claim); ambulances and school vehicles stuck. Nagar Palika EO says a budget proposal to reinstall barricades has been sent.

negatives.english: The 1919 government hospital building in Khurja is dilapidated and its chhajja could fall any time
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा के जटिया अस्पताल की 1919 की इमारत जर्जर है, छज्जे कभी भी गिर सकते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Sep 2026): Sri Lakshman Das Jatiya Rajkiya Chikitsalaya building built 1919, walls and lintels deteriorating, old staff quarters fully dilapidated with chhajjas that could fall; a chhajja of a 100-year-old Subhash Marg building in Khurja collapsed on 19 July 2026. ADM says construction of new buildings is under process.

negatives.english: Khurja Junction has no drinking water and little shade for passengers, and the station upgrade is unfinished
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा जंक्शन पर न पीने का पानी है, न छांव, यात्री परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline, 4 Jun 2026): Amrit Station 2.0 redevelopment (Rs 12.5 crore, foundation Feb 2024) not finished; platforms 1-4 lack working drinking water, coolers broken; only about 30 m of the 600 m platform 3-4 area has tin shed; Station Superintendent says old sheds will be replaced and a letter sent to repair coolers.

notes: AC identity: the Wikipedia list-page fetch first returned Gautam Buddha Nagar as district for row 70; this was a reading error. The list's Bulandshahr group heading (constituencies 64-70) and the Khurja Assembly constituency page both give Bulandshahr district, SC reserved, extent Khurja Tehsil. Lok Sabha seat is Gautam Buddha Nagar. No Hindi name on the Wikipedia pages. The Khurja medical college, GT Road, Gandhi Marg, the 1919 hospital building, Khurja Junction, and the 6-8 hour power figure are all Khurja-named. The power figure comes from a district-wide table, so it is district-level in origin. Positive 2 (660 MW thermal unit) is at Dashehra village, Khurja per the article; tehsil membership not verified against the extent. Positives 4 and 5 are started or sanctioned work, not completed works; no completed project in Khurja was found. Searches for Khurja gas or pottery cost issues in 2025-26, stray cattle, sugarcane dues specific to Khurja, and Khurja drinking-water contamination returned nothing local; those are not included. The Kali river pollution report (21 Sep 2026) names Khurja on the river's banks but is river-level, so it was left out. The CT scan item is in Bulandshahr city, not Khurja, so it was excluded.
